headlines.description: — In his previous visit to Atlanta, Bryce Young commanded the spotlight.
headlines.shortLinkText: Young throws 3 TD passes, including 2 to Waller, as Panthers dominate short-handed Falcons 34-3

headlines.description: — Dallas Turner threw Tyson Bagent to the ground, then took off down the field in celebration. It rained on his parade, for sure, but that was just fine with him.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers and Turner help the Vikings shut down the Bears for a 9-3 win in the rain

headlines.description: — Philadelphia coach Nick Sirianni had only one thought with his offense on the field on a day so hot he needed intravenous fluids to cool off.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jalen Hurts hits Darius Cooper for TD with 9 seconds left to lift the Eagles past the Titans 24-20

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New England Patriots

headlines.shortLinkText: TreVeyon Henderson runs for a TD and the Patriots pummel Aaron Rodgers in a 20-3 win over Steelers

events.name: Green Bay Packers at New York Jets

headlines.description: — Jordan Love and the Green Bay Packers were down 10 points in the fourth quarter, piling penalties and staring at a seventh consecutive loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trey Smack’s OT kick lifts the Packers past the Jets, ending a 6-game skid

events.name: Cleveland Browns at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: — Deshaun Watson outplayed Baker Mayfield and earned at least a few more starts for the Cleveland Browns.
headlines.shortLinkText: Deshaun Watson outplays Baker Mayfield, leading the Browns to a 23-19 win over the Buccaneers

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: — Twice in a row, Tyler Shough disappeared into a pile of bodies at the goal line with the game tied late in the fourth quarter.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tyler Shough and the Saints produce two big drives at the end to topple the Ravens 24-17

headlines.description: — Ja'Marr Chase reminded everyone of just how good he can be on Sunday after the five-time Pro Bowler was a non-factor in Cincinnati's season-opening win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ja'Marr Chase scores 2 TDs on passes from Joe Burrow to lead the Bengals past the Texans 20-6
Jaylen Waddle’s quiet Denver debut flips into a 138-yard day in a Broncos' 20-13 comeback over Jags

events.name: Las Vegas Raiders at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: — Kirk Cousins used to watch Cody White attacking the football at Michigan State. The veteran quarterback figured the same thing would work for the Las Vegas Raiders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kirk Cousins connects with Cody White for 2 TDs and Raiders beat Chargers 26-14

headlines.description: — Dak Prescott celebrated breaking Tony Romo's career franchise record for touchdown passes in a victorious locker room for the Dallas Cowboys.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott throws 4 TD passes as Cowboys beat Commanders, who again lose Daniels to dislocated elbow

headlines.shortLinkText: Drew Lock connects for 3 TDs with Jaxon Smith-Njigba; Seahawks roll past Cardinals 31-7

headlines.description: — The San Francisco 49ers handled the return from Australia just as well as the trip there and have started the season with two convincing victories.
headlines.shortLinkText: 49ers score TDs on 1st 5 drives to beat the Dolphins 35-13

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: — The Kansas City Chiefs thought they had beaten the Indianapolis Colts on a bizarre fumble in overtime Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes and Walker shine, Butker hits winning 40-yarder as Chiefs beat Colts 33-30 in OT
